b1-rakoczi-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why People Followed Rákóczi
b1-rakoczi-01.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks why many Hungarians supported Rákóczi in 1703.
b1-rakoczi-01.prompt: Tell the official why many nobles were dissatisfied and what Rákóczi did in 1703.
cues: Say why many nobles were dissatisfied
b1-rakoczi-01.target: Sok nemes elégedetlen volt, mert a bécsi udvar elvette a birtokaikat. 1703-ban Rákóczi fegyverbe szólította a népet.
b1-rakoczi-01.english: Many nobles were dissatisfied because the Viennese court had taken their estates. In 1703 Rákóczi called the people to arms.
b1-rakoczi-01.canDo: I can explain who Ferenc Rákóczi II was and why he issued the Brezán Proclamation.

b1-rakoczi-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Kuruc Uprising
b1-rakoczi-02.scenario: On a museum visit, the guide asks you to describe how the uprising looked in its first months.
b1-rakoczi-02.prompt: Tell the guide what the Kuruc and the labanc troops did at the same time and what the rebels took control of.
cues: Say what the Kuruc did while the labanc waited
Say what the rebels took control of
b1-rakoczi-02.target: Míg a kurucok a hegyekben gyűltek, a labanc csapatok a síkságon vártak. Rövid idő alatt a felkelők az ország nagy része fölött átvették az irányítást.
b1-rakoczi-02.english: While the Kuruc gathered in the hills, the labanc troops waited on the plain. In a short time the rebels took control of most of the country.
b1-rakoczi-02.canDo: I can describe how the Kuruc uprising began and how the Kuruc army fought.

b1-rakoczi-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Setbacks and Success
b1-rakoczi-03.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks about the war after the Diet of Ónód.
b1-rakoczi-03.prompt: Tell the official that the Kuruc held most of the country but struggled with the castles, and that they fought on although the copper coin lost value.
cues: Say the Kuruc held most of the country
Say what was hard for them
Say they fought on although the coin lost value
b1-rakoczi-03.target: Bár a kurucok az ország nagy részét uralták, a várakat nehezen vették be. Annak ellenére, hogy a rézpénz értéke csökkent, tovább harcoltak.
b1-rakoczi-03.english: Although the Kuruc ruled most of the country, they took the castles with difficulty. Even though the value of the copper coin fell, they kept fighting.
b1-rakoczi-03.canDo: I can describe the 1707 Diet of Ónód and why the war began to turn against the Kuruc.

b1-rakoczi-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Peace of Szatmár
b1-rakoczi-04.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks how the war of independence ended.
b1-rakoczi-04.prompt: Tell the official where an agreement was reached, what the peace promised the rebels and who did not accept it.
cues: Say where the agreement was reached
Say who did not accept the terms
b1-rakoczi-04.target: Szatmáron megállapodás született. A béke amnesztiát ígért a felkelőknek, de Rákóczi személyesen nem fogadta el.
b1-rakoczi-04.english: An agreement was reached at Szatmár. The peace promised the rebels an amnesty, but Rákóczi personally did not accept it.
b1-rakoczi-04.canDo: I can describe how the Peace of Szatmár ended the war in 1711.

b1-rakoczi-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Remembering Rákóczi
b1-rakoczi-05.scenario: A history teacher asks you where Rákóczi lived in exile and how he is remembered.
b1-rakoczi-05.prompt: Tell the teacher where Rákóczi lived at the end of his life, who wrote about the exiles, and how many people see Rákóczi.
cues: Say where Rákóczi lived in exile
Say who wrote about the exiles
Say what many people see in Rákóczi
b1-rakoczi-05.target: Rákóczi Rodostóban élt. Mikes Kelemen a Törökországi levelekben írt a bujdosókról. Sokan a függetlenség jelképének tekintik Rákóczit.
b1-rakoczi-05.english: Rákóczi lived in Rodostó. Kelemen Mikes wrote about the exiles in the Letters from Turkey. Many regard Rákóczi as a symbol of independence.
b1-rakoczi-05.canDo: I can explain what happened to Rákóczi after the war and how he is remembered.

b1-rakoczi-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The War of Independence in Brief
b1-rakoczi-consolidation.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks you to summarise the Rákóczi War of Independence in a few sentences.
b1-rakoczi-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official when the war broke out, how it ended and where Rákóczi lived afterwards.
cues: Say when the war broke out
b1-rakoczi-consolidation.target: 1703-ban kitört a Rákóczi-szabadságharc. 1711-ben a szatmári béke lezárta a háborút, Rákóczi pedig Rodostóban élt.
b1-rakoczi-consolidation.english: The Rákóczi War of Independence broke out in 1703. In 1711 the Peace of Szatmár ended the war, and Rákóczi lived in Rodostó.
b1-rakoczi-consolidation.canDo: I can retell the main events of the 1703–1711 Rákóczi War of Independence.
